reviewItem.question: Does "Sigstore Bundle Verification: Kyverno 1.13 introduces support for verifying container images signatures that use the sigstore bundle format" mean a change to protocol-behavior:kyverno|name=sigstore-bundle-verification (added)?

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for verifying container image signatures that use the sigstore bundle format via the new verification type `SigstoreBundle`, enabling verification of GitHub Artifact Attestations (e.g. SLSA Provenance).
